backend.name: local signing command and certificate files

distribution.reason: Local file-signer candidate: upstream MIT grant verified; actual base/bundled-tool/layer review and digest-bound source companion/delivery remain incomplete. Signing baseline is falsified; only bounded native RSA/P-256 observations are retained.

constraints: Linux amd64/glibc 2.41. Module dynamically links the frozen Debian system libcrypto.so.3 and C++ runtime. Source tag v1.0.0 and main were both verified at 8fddf3b4cec6bf5d4287f71f5c3c4a7cfc9c7aa3, so channels legitimately share provider bytes; their selector and build identities remain distinct.

NO authentication or PIN inputs. Native C_Login/C_Logout unconditionally return CKR_OK even for invalid handles/roles. Token flags omit CKF_LOGIN_REQUIRED and PIN bounds are 0/0; C_InitToken/C_InitPIN/C_SetPIN return CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED (0x54). Key-file possession and command execution are signing authority.

First init generates disposable RSA-2048 and P-256 keys and self-signed certificates at runtime; no baked keys or upstream test fixtures. Bind caller-owned writable /var/lib/p11lab. The owned pkcs11-to-cmd directory is 0700, all six files 0600. Runtime-generated keys are the only managed provisioning mode.

Sparse slots: 0 RSA, 1 empty, 2 P-256; immutable native labels pkcs11-to-cmd-0 and pkcs11-to-cmd-2. C_GetSlotList(CK_TRUE) incorrectly includes the empty slot; NUL-filled native token-label tails are preserved. One session per process; no general-token claim.

P2C_SLOT_CERT_0/2, P2C_CMD and P2C_DEBUG are fixed non-secret native wiring. Equal overrides are accepted; unequal or extra slot controls fail before persistent state is opened. P2C_CERT and P2C_MECHANISM are outputs set by the native module.

Each init/health/exec reserves a private 0700 directory under /run/p11lab with unique P2C_DATA/P2C_SIG paths. The signing-directory wrapper preserves the application CWD. Incoming data/signature controls are refused. Upstream uses relative r.bin/s.bin for EC conversion, so only the unchanged upstream signing command runs in that private directory. Temporary signing files live until command/container shutdown; use private tmpfs /run/p11lab for each container.

init requires empty state and takes .init-lock; complete seals artifact identity and exact public wiring. Compatible repeated init validates and preserves keys. health validates ownership, modes, links, roster, exact marker/wiring and certificate/key equality before native module readiness. No silent reset; partial/corrupt/conflicting state is retained. The native helper makes no login or provisioning calls.

exec -- ARGV preserves arbitrary argv and exit status after readiness. No card, daemon, server/server-ready or remote signing CLI is started. Serialize consumers of each key store and use independent state/processes/tmpfs for shards. Explicitly remove the entire owned state only after all consumers stop to reset.

The signing baseline is falsified by native NUL token-label tails and unsupported C_GetMechanismList/C_GetMechanismInfo (0x54). The pkcs11-to-cmd-signing exception records narrow explicit-mechanism native signing with independent positive/altered-input verification; it does not repair discovery or qualify the common consumer.

PKCS#11 2.40 declaration plus unsupported discovery/encrypt/decrypt/digest/keygen/import/wrap/derive/verify/RNG are adversarial capability-honesty observations. Preserve original RVs and classifier outcomes; unsupported calls are not normalized into success.

RSA uses the upstream raw-digest pkeyutl command behavior; no standard DigestInfo/RSA dgst compatibility claim. P-256 native raw-digest signing is independently checked. Other curves/mechanisms, concurrent/crash/certificate-trust/expiry/hardware/platform behavior and full provider/checker/proxy qualification remain unqualified.

Basic runtime has only provider/closure/readiness/OpenSSL/xxd/signing shell command. Optional consumer/checker/proxy artifacts are separately pinned; remote use requires the compatible pkcs11-proxy-ng daemon/client shim and documented isolation limits. Whole-image rights/source delivery and public qualification remain blocked.
